violation_type.title: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 747.307 within 5 Days (26 TAC §747.309(a))
violation_type.short_title: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 747.307 within 5 Days
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation notified all parents of a safe sleep deficiency, but failed to notify all parents with children enrolled of the safe sleep deficiency within the required time frame of 5 days.     Note: This was corrected during the inspection when the the permit holder signed a written statement that she understands all safe sleep deficiencies require that all parents be notified within 5 days of receiving the deficiency.
